apk_sha256_note: Computed by the GoyTeam GitHub Actions workflow and attached to the release artifact as StudioMobile-GoyTeam-v<version>.apk.sha256.

engine.decoder_binary_rbxl: LZ4 chunks (META/SSTR/INST/PROP/PRNT) with structure-of-arrays values; ZSTD chunks are detected and reported as unsupported
engine.renderer: OpenGL ES 2.0, box geometry, real size/CFrame/color
engine.lighting: Lighting service pipeline: ClockTime/GeographicLatitude sun, Ambient/OutdoorAmbient, ColorShift_Top/Bottom, Brightness, EnvironmentDiffuseScale/EnvironmentSpecularScale, FogStart/FogEnd/FogColor, ExposureCompensation, Enum.Material metalness/roughness/emissive/reflectance, Sky (sun/stars/gradient), Atmosphere (density/offset/haze/glare/decay/color), Clouds (cover/density/color), PointLight/SpotLight/SurfaceLight (4 shaded per frame), ColorCorrectionEffect, BloomEffect, BlurEffect, SunRaysEffect
engine.lighting_not_rendered: shadow maps (GlobalShadows/ShadowSoftness are read and reported), DepthOfFieldEffect, ColorGradingEffect tone mapping, Roblox skybox/cloud textures (procedural sky is drawn instead), SurfaceAppearance/MaterialVariant maps
engine.editor_crash_handling: Place decode, editor construction, GL pipeline creation and each frame catch failures and report them in-app (with the trace for startup failures) instead of crashing

verification.engine_unit_tests: app/src/test/java/dev/falix/studiomobile/EngineCoreTest.java, 22 tests (LZ4, planar/zig-zag binary arrays, CFrame rotations, synthetic binary place decode, ray picking, character collision, lighting: sun arc and latitude, Roblox defaults, Lighting property mapping, Sky/Atmosphere/Clouds, post-effect gating, local lights, material table, fixture place lighting) - run with ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest
verification.shader_validation: EngineRenderer GLSL ES 1.00 sources verified with glslangValidator (10/10 shaders compile); no on-device GPU capture was possible for this host

screenshots: Only real captures are accepted. Historical QA screenshots in this repository are native View.draw captures excluding system overlays. No fabricated cloud account or device run is claimed for 0.5.0.

ci.release_channel: Rolling prerelease tag debug-latest is updated on every push to main; tags publish permanent releases
ci.signing: Shared committed debug certificate keystore/debug.keystore (alias goyteam-debug) so every GoyTeam debug build installs over the previous one
